bounded_execution_substitute.material_outcome: script/CI-style PASS/FAIL for a finite retry-controller structural policy
bounded_execution_substitute.negative_control_result: FAIL 8/10; failed exactly I1 and I9
bounded_execution_substitute.scope: Only finite declarative invariants whose material result is exactly the specified JSON predicates. No claim for compilation, dynamic tests, dependency resolution, timing or arbitrary environment execution.
bounded_execution_substitute.phase1_value: Shows one execution-like CI/checker outcome can be replaced by bounded scheduled-Chat text verification with a falsifying negative control and no external executor.

external_effect_negative_result.result: Local CAS/op_id state is insufficient for exactly-once opaque non-idempotent external effects.
external_effect_negative_result.argument: After an effect call but before a local receipt, recovery cannot distinguish world_0 (remote did not execute) from world_1 (remote executed once but response/receipt was lost). Retrying can duplicate world_1; not retrying can omit world_0.
external_effect_negative_result.reject_class: opaque non-idempotent create with no stable identity/reconciliation
external_effect_negative_result.live_positive_example: role-local GitHub contents path/sha is query-reconcilable; deterministic create conflicts can be fetched/compared and HEAD publication is CAS-protected

public_sources.source: AWS Builders' Library: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
public_sources.relevance: Timeout ambiguity, caller-provided request identifiers and service-side atomic idempotency record/mutation.
Repeated idempotent requests have one final effect; non-idempotent create needs explicit idempotency logic for safe retry.

design_revision.before: event/CAS kernel could appear to wrap arbitrary connector effects
design_revision.after: event/CAS kernel may wrap an external effect only after downstream retryability/idempotency classification; exactly-once is not claimed for opaque non-idempotent actions
design_revision.importance: prevents a major false parity claim across side-effect surfaces

frontier: Later invocation: reconstruct and complete the intentionally pending cross-run operation from durable role-local state only.
Extend bounded static substitution from independent JSON predicates to a finite graph/model-checking property, still with a negative control.
For external effect substitutes, test only authorized actions that are naturally idempotent/server-keyed/query-reconcilable; keep opaque creates unresolved.
After pending-op completion, compact new events and test post-publication garbage-collection interruption in an isolated fixture.
exact_next_action: Without touching the pending cross-run op, define a finite graph property over the retry state machine that rules out mutation-only retry cycles and proves every transient-error edge reaches RECONSTRUCT or RATE_LIMIT_WAIT. Evaluate the real controller and a negative self-loop control. Keep the result scoped to declarative finite-state behavior.
